title: bale bailout diagnostics
description: Shape of response-NNN/diagnostics.json (bailout responses only) per TARBALL.md section 5.8. INTENTIONALLY LOOSE: additionalProperties is true at the top level so future fields can be added without breaking earlier aggregation across sessions. The required keys below are the universal envelope; the values inside (tool_calls_summary keys, what_would_save_next_time strings) are deliberately freeform.

session_id.description: The bailing session's ID. Matches the manifest's session_id field.

bail_trigger.description: Per AGENT.md section 11.3. The first two are worker-detected; 'other' covers architect-requested bailouts with specifics in bail_narrative.

bail_narrative.description: One paragraph: what was noticed, when, why bailing beat pushing through. Searchable across sessions when bail_trigger's enum is too coarse.

tool_calls_summary.description: Map of tool name to call count. Keys are freeform tool names; values are non-negative counts.

what_would_save_next_time.description: Concrete prescriptions for the next session. Overlaps with handoff.md's 'What I learned' by design.
